text:
ayan: Seeing ~400ms p99 increase from BOM POP starting ~2026-03-18 02:07 UTC. Spike correlates with a sharp rise in DNS latency and KV cache evictions. Canaries that rolled back the batching heuristic look better. Who's oncall?
priya: @ayan on it — grabbing tcpdump + perf traces. Do we have SERVFAILs or NXDOMAINs?
ayan: Mostly SERVFAIL and large DNS RTTs (150-350ms). Backend connects show high tcp connect times to SG egress: connect_time=0.28s vs baseline ~0.02s. Also seeing increased cross-region egress from BOM->SG.
jean: Profile shows kernel-selector metric "kernel_choice_flips" jumped ~3x at the same time. Flips cause fallback kernels (low-throughput) to be chosen, tokens/sec down.
maria: KV cache hit rate fell 92% -> 56% around 02:06, eviction rate spiked. Looks like routing/DNS churn is making many requests miss the prefix/KV cache.
priya: Running a quick local canary: disabled new batching heuristic (reverted to previous) at 02:24 and observed p99 drop back to ~baseline in canary hosts. Pushing revert to a small subset of prod now.
sre-bot: deploy noted: revert-batching-heuristic by @priya at 1999123485 (:rocket:)
ayan: After partial revert, BOM p99 dropped to baseline for the reverted pool. Non-reverted hosts still noisy. GCP egress appears to intermittently prefer SG cloud egress path with high RTTs. Opening GCP ticket.
jean: Suggest adding a short-circuit in kernel selector: if backend conn RTT > 100ms prefer stable kernel instead of flip. Current heuristics treat transient RTT the same as sustained.
maria: Also propose TTL smoothing: provider returned very short TTLs (~2s) for some records which caused repeated lookups. If DNS TTL < 5s treat as 30s for cache index purposes.
priya: I'll take the kernel selector guard and KV warmup mitigation. @maria can you own TTL smoothing + support ticket draft?
maria: On it. Drafting ticket with dig logs, pcap, and perf traces.
ayan: Saved captures and perf traces to /internal/journal/1999123456 (pcap + perf.data + trace.json).
priya: Quick paste of the notable log snippet: ```
[02:06:12] dns.lookup bomb-host.redwood -> SERVFAIL (rtt=0.29s)
[02:06:12] connect backend sg-e1 35.202.10.45: connect_time=0.283s
[02:06:12] kernel_selector: chosen=fallback_low_mem reason=flip_count>3
[02:06:13] kvcache: evict_count=1245 hit_rate=0.56
```
jean: Action items: 1) GCP ticket (maria) 2) kernel selector guard (priya) 3) DNS TTL smoothing (maria) 4) KV-cache warmup on failover + temporary higher eviction threshold (priya) 5) add metric to alert on cross-region egress spike (ayan)
maria: I'll escalate the GCP ticket once I attach pcap and dig output. Noted recommendation to request egress path investigation.
ayan: Marking incident P2. Reverting batching widely if latency doesn't stabilize in next 30m. Update thread when GCP responds or if revert needs to expand.
